summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression testing of Rx Sync med reminder app. 21/22 backend tests PASS (95.5%). Key regressions verified: (a) /routines/today returns bounded 6 doses (NOT hundreds) - clean seed confirmed; (b) /medications/check-interactions completes in <2s and no longer blocks the event loop (asyncio.to_thread fix verified with 5 drugs including Aspirin+Warfarin Severe pair). Frontend Expo web preview loads cleanly on mobile viewport, bottom tab navigation (Today, Scan Rx, Drug Info, Caregiver, Refills, Clinic) is visible and functional, Emergency SOS opens a Tier-2 confirmation modal, Feeling Well/Unwell toggle, Clinical Interaction banner (Metformin+Lisinopril Minor), and scheduled doses '3 of 6 Taken' all render correctly. Portal switching (Patient -> Caregiver/Clinic) works. One backend bug: magic-link claim endpoint 404s because it uppercases the code (`rx-XXXXXX` becomes `RX-XXXXXX`) that was stored with lowercase `rx-` prefix. Missing testID attributes across React Native components (no data-testid found on any interactive element) - flagged for testability. Deprecated `shadow*` style props warnings in console.

critical.issue: Endpoint returns 404 for a freshly created magic link. Root cause: `create-magic-link` stores code as `rx-XXXXXX` (lowercase `rx-` prefix + uppercase hex), but `claim-magic-link` looks it up with `code.upper()` producing `RX-XXXXXX`, which never matches. Fix: use case-insensitive lookup (regex) or store/lookup with a consistent case (e.g., always uppercase both parts). File: /app/backend/server.py:829

issues: Console shows deprecated 'shadow*' style prop warnings from React Native web - should migrate to boxShadow

react_native_issues.issue: No `testID` attributes found on any element in the DOM (0 data-testid nodes). Buttons, TouchableOpacity, TextInput, tab bar items lack testIDs - severely limits automated testing. Add testID to key elements in /app/frontend/src/components/ and /app/frontend/app/index.tsx

Deprecated 'shadow*' style props used (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius). Should migrate to `boxShadow` for React Native Web compatibility. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ (multiple)

action_items: Fix magic-link claim casing bug: change lookup in /app/backend/server.py line 829 to case-insensitive match (e.g., `{'code': {'$regex': f'^{code}$', '$options': 'i'}}`) or normalize both create and claim to same case.

Add `testID` prop to all interactive React Native components (buttons, TextInput, tab bar items, modals, SOS confirm button) in /app/frontend/src/components/ and /app/frontend/app/index.tsx to enable robust automation.
Migrate deprecated `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` in StyleSheet definitions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1780 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, medications, prescriptions, health, pharmacist, clinic, dispatch) for maintainability (>700 line rule).
MongoDB `_id` fields are correctly stripped via `serialize_doc`.
check-interactions correctly uses `asyncio.to_thread` + `gather` for RxNorm calls (regression fix verified).
seed_database only seeds when users collection is empty - idempotent for cold start but won't re-seed after partial deletions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (loads, navigation, SOS modal, portal switch, banners all working)

seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data created. Tests use existing seeded patient_ramesh_001. Test-created medications are archived (soft-deleted via `active: false`) by DELETE endpoint after verify-and-save test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://medication-companion-3.preview.emergentagent.com. All endpoints under /api. Demo OTP is 123456 for all 4 roles. Patient ID: patient_ramesh_001. Seed provides 4 active meds and 5 today doses (one may become 6 after test_log_dose runs). Magic-link create/claim casing bug is the only failing test. Frontend has NO testID attributes - selectors must rely on text content or CSS. Language toggle is via header 'English' pill; requires dropdown interaction not tested here.
rca_of_issue: Magic link 404 RCA: In /app/backend/server.py, `create_magic_link` at line 798 generates `code = f'rx-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}'` producing e.g. 'rx-A3F4B1' (lowercase 'rx-' prefix). The document is stored with that exact string. At line 829, `claim_magic_link` executes `db.magic_links.find_one({'code': code.upper()})` which searches for 'RX-A3F4B1' - MongoDB is case-sensitive so no match, returns 404. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/create-magic-link -> receive code 'rx-XXXXXX' -> GET /api/auth/claim-magic-link/rx-XXXXXX -> 404. Mitigation: replace `code.upper()` with case-insensitive regex query, or normalize casing in both create and lookup.
